dossier.public_summary: The dip appears deep in some sectors and almost absent in others, and odd versus even dips differ by a factor of two. Stellar-activity or noise cannot explain this: the depth truly changes within the same data product and several individual transits are much deeper, much shallower, or missing entirely. The pattern is best explained by a variable blend or systematic false alarm, not a planet.

reasons.why: Odd and even transits differ strongly, favours eccentric binary or odd/even binary at twice period.
